title: Turning worlds
summary: The worlds turn: every world spins on its own axis, the sun rising and setting every few minutes (a Day length setting), with the time to sunrise and sunset on the HUD. Towns are laid out in blocks between streets, lit at night by lamps in each empire's style; main roads join the cities and cross water on stone bridges, you walk faster on them, and they show on the planet map. Each city's landing field has pads where ships land and lift off, their pilots walking into town - and selling rides, to other systems too. The sea is new, with lakes and rivers and their rapids, a deeper sea floor and a better underwater. The automaton's rifle folds into a compartment on its thigh; the mushroom mammoth is a towering, calm beast of its own. Plants keep their detail further and fade leaf by leaf, and every model gets levels of detail. Landed ships are solid to their shape and you can walk into them. And smaller things: animals keep out of towns, the compass names the mark you face, news in the event log only from near you, one map icon.

steps.title: The worlds turn
steps.text: Every world now turns on its own axis: the sun rises in the east and sets in the west, a day and a night together 16 to 24 minutes - each at most 12 minutes where towns stand. The ground, towns and plants turn with the world; you, the animals, the people and your landed ship are carried round with it. A Day length setting (8 minutes to 2 hours, or no turning); the HUD shows the time to sunrise and sunset, and the compass names the mark you face.

steps.title: Towns: streets, blocks and lamps
steps.text: Cities and villages are laid out in blocks between paved streets - each empire its own plan: rings round a Minoan palace, an Athenian grid, long Spartan streets, Cycladic lanes. Street lamps in each empire's style - posts, wall lamps, hung oil lamps, braziers - light the towns at night, the nearest casting real light. Animals keep out of the towns.

steps.title: Roads, bridges, faster on the way
steps.text: Roads leave by the gate facing the next town and run into its streets. Main roads join the cities - every inhabited world has two at least - paved near them; where they cross water, stone bridges in the empire's style, with piers, arches, parapets and lamps, solid to walk on. On a road or a street you walk and run a third faster. The roads show on the planet map, as far as you've seen, and keep off the landing fields.

steps.title: Landing pads, traffic, pilots
steps.text: Each city's landing field has three to six pads in its empire's style with a control tower. Shuttles, traders and couriers come down from the sky, stay a few minutes and lift off; their pilots walk down the ramp into town and back. Ask one for a ride - to a station, a city on another world, or another system through the gates.

diagram.text: only near you: 4-6 ships at a field

steps.title: Water: sea, lakes and rivers
steps.text: A new sea surface: layered waves, foam on the crests and the shores, the sky reflected, the bottom seen through the shallows. Lakes fill the basins and rivers run from the highlands to the sea - some through rapids whose current sweeps you along. The sea floor drops away from the shore; swimming builds up like the run. Under the water, the surface from below and the light in shafts; no snowfall down there.

steps.title: The folding rifle, the mammoth
steps.text: The automaton's rifle - about seventy parts - folds piece by piece into a block and stows in an armoured compartment on the right thigh, its lid swinging open to draw it; your own edited automaton gets it too. The mushroom mammoth stands 14 m at the shoulder, its own detailed model under a red-capped fungus, walking and grazing like an elephant, calm until it's hurt.

steps.title: Detail at a distance
steps.text: Plants keep their full detail further and lose it leaf by leaf - six levels down to a picture, with no swap you can see. Every other model - characters, creatures, towns, ships, stations, rocks - now has simpler versions chosen by its size on screen: up to two-thirds fewer triangles drawn in a dungeon, two-fifths in a town.

steps.title: Ships solid; walk into them
steps.text: Landed ships are solid as they're shaped - you stop at the hull, walk under a high belly or a wing, stand on a hull - and you can walk up the ramp into every ship with room inside, to its pilot's seat and out again. The camera stays in the rooms aboard. Also: one map icon (M) and the guide's (F1), news within 2 km in the event log, and people who don't walk on the spot.

+def _track(n, pts):
+    """A control's value each frame 0..n-1 from (frame, value[, "io"]) points: straight between them, or eased."""
+    out = []
+    for f in range(n):

+static func simplify(pts: PackedVector3Array, eps: float) -> PackedVector3Array:
+	if pts.size() < 3:
+		return pts
+	var keep := PackedByteArray()
+	keep.resize(pts.size())
+	keep[0] = 1
+	keep[pts.size() - 1] = 1
+	var stack: Array = [[0, pts.size() - 1]]
+	while not stack.is_empty():
+		var se: Array = stack.pop_back()
+		var a: int = se[0]
+		var b: int = se[1]
+		var worst := -1.0
+		var wi := -1
+		for i in range(a + 1, b):
+			var d := Geometry3D.get_closest_point_to_segment(pts[i], pts[a], pts[b]).distance_to(pts[i])
+			if d > worst:
+				worst = d
+				wi = i
+		if wi >= 0 and worst > eps:
+			keep[wi] = 1
+			stack.append([a, wi])
+			stack.append([wi, b])
+	var out := PackedVector3Array()
+	for i in pts.size():
+		if keep[i]:
+			out.append(pts[i])
+	return out
+
+
+## The roads that leave town `i` of the world shown, as they come to its gates - town-local
+## [x, z] points from its gate outward (~150 m), and main: [[PackedVector2Array, main]].
+func town_ways(i: int) -> Array:
+	var out: Array = []
+	if _t.is_empty() or i < 0 or i >= (_t["towns"] as Array).size():
+		return out
+	var roads := CosmosRoads.cached(CosmosRoads.key_of(_t["rec"]))
+	var s: Dictionary = _t["towns"][i]
+	var R: float = _t["radius"]
+	var inv := CosmosTown.frame(s, R).affine_inverse()
+	for r in roads:
+		var pts: PackedVector3Array = r["pts"]
+		var dr: Vector2i = r.get("drawn", Vector2i(0, pts.size() - 1))
+		var line := PackedVector2Array()
+		if int(r["a"]) == i:
+			for k in range(dr.x, mini(dr.x + 60, dr.y + 1)):
+				var q: Vector3 = inv * (pts[k] * (R + float(s["h"])))
+				line.append(Vector2(q.x, q.z))
+		elif int(r["b"]) == i:
+			for k in range(dr.y, maxi(dr.y - 60, dr.x - 1), -1):
+				var q: Vector3 = inv * (pts[k] * (R + float(s["h"])))
+				line.append(Vector2(q.x, q.z))
+		if line.size() >= 2:
+			out.append([line, bool(r.get("main", false))])

files.explanation: New: the cities' landing pads and their traffic. Each city gets 3-6 pads in its empire's look with a control tower; ships come down, stay and lift off on a schedule worked out from the galaxy clock, flown only near you, and their pilots walk into the town and offer rides.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,737 @@ 
+class_name CosmosLandingField
+extends Node
+## The towns' landing pads and their traffic (the 3D game; a child of Cosmos).
+##   The pads - beside a city's landing field, on the levelled ground at the
+##     town's edge: 3-6 a city (by its seed), 0-1 a village. Big pads (a
+##     shuttle's: its length + 4 m by 27 m) two rows each side of the field, a
+##     courier's small one (24 m) past them; each in its empire's look
+##     (EmpireKit: its paint, the hazard band, the roundel with its emblem, a
+##     chevron at its nose end), lamps round its edges lit by night (the town
+##     shader's lamp slot, as the streets' lamps), and a control tower at the
+##     field's far end with its beacon. One mesh (and one of lamps) a town,
+##     built on a worker when its town is; their solids added to the town's
+##     (walked on, the camera's obstacles).
+##   The traffic - each pad's rounds (CYCLE s): in most a ship comes down on it
+##     (a shuttle - local traders and the pilots' own - or a courier's skiff,
+##     the empire's EmpireHulls designs), sits a few minutes and lifts off. Its
+##     schedule is a function of the galaxy's clock and the pad (slot): far
+##     from you it's only those numbers; within NEAR m the ship's there, flown
+##     here (fly: in from the sky, down onto the pad, its ramp down; up, away
+##     and gone). A pad is one ship's at a time; none come down on one your ship
+##     is on; one hired off it (CosmosSandbox) leaves it free for that round.
+##   Its pilot - when it's down near you, a named pilot walks down its ramp
+##     (CosmosNpc.leave_ship) into the town - its square, a house's door, the
+##     palace's colonnade - stays there, walks back and up the ramp before it
+##     lifts off. Talk to him for a ride (CosmosSandbox: this system's stations,
+##     a town on another world, systems through the gates - a price each).
+## Saved: only the rounds taken by a hire (CosmosGame.extra "pads_taken");
+## the rest comes back from the clock - a ship mid-stay is there again, its pilot ashore.
+##   CosmosLandingField.of(cosmos)
+
+const CLASS := "res://scripts/world/life/cosmos_landing_field.gd"
+const NEAR := 2600.0            # m: a pad's ship flown within this of you
+const GONE := 3200.0            # ...and back to numbers past this
+const ASHORE := 420.0           # m: its pilot out in the town within this (the town's people's reach)
+const SIM_HZ := 4.0
+const CYCLE := 420.0            # s: a pad's round
+const APPROACH := 34.0          # s: from the sky down onto it
+const LIFT := 26.0              # s: off it and gone
+const STAY := [150.0, 260.0]    # s down on it
+const BUSY := 0.72              # of the rounds a ship comes
+const DECK := 0.12              # m: the pads' decks over the ground
+const ROW_W := 27.0             # m: a big pad's width (along the field's edge)
+const SMALL := 24.0
+const TOWER := Vector3(40.0, 0.0, 0.0)   # (from the field's middle: its far end)
+const PEOPLE := {"minoa": "Minoans", "athens": "Athenians", "sparta": "Spartans", "mycenae": "Mycenaeans", "ionia": "Ionians", "cyclades": "Islanders"}
+const EMPS := ["minoa", "athens", "sparta", "mycenae", "ionia", "cyclades"]
+
+var cosmos: Node
+var live := {}                  # pad key -> {ship, pilot, slot, town, pad, state, t, near}
+var _sim_t := 0.0
+var _jobs := {}                 # town -> [job, result]
+static var test_busy := -1.0    # (tests: every round busy (1) or none (0))
+
+
+static func of(c: Node) -> Node:
+	var n := c.get_node_or_null("LandingField")
+	if n == null:
+		n = load(CLASS).new()
+		n.name = "LandingField"
+		n.set("cosmos", c)
+		c.add_child(n)
+	return n
+
+
+# --- The pads -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## A town's pads (town-local, y up): [{id, at (its deck's middle, on top), size (x along the
+## town's x - a ship's length - , y along z), big}]. Only those on its levelled ground.
+static func pads_of(site: Dictionary) -> Array:
+	var kind := str(site.get("kind", "village"))
+	var lay := CosmosTown.layout(kind)
+	var half: float = lay["half"]
+	var port: Vector3 = lay["port"]
+	var r: float = float(site.get("r", 130.0))
+	var emp := str(site.get("empire", ""))
+	var length := CosmosHull.size_of("shuttle", emp) * 22.0 + 4.0
+	var x0 := half + 12.0   # (room between the town's edge and a ship's stern for its ramp, and a way along it)
+	var out: Array = []
+	var seed := int(site.get("seed", 0))
+	var want := (3 + absi(seed) % 4) if kind == "city" else (absi(seed / 7) % 2)
+	for spec in [[0, -1.0], [0, 1.0], [1, -1.0], [1, 1.0], [2, -1.0], [2, 1.0]]:
+		if out.size() >= want:
+			break
+		var row: int = spec[0]
+		var big := row < 2
+		var w := ROW_W if big else SMALL
+		var l := length if big else SMALL
+		var z0 := port.z + 37.0 + row * 29.0   # (clear of the field's stone and its lamps; 2 m between)
+		var c := Vector3(x0 + l * 0.5, DECK, float(spec[1]) * (z0 + w * 0.5))
+		var far := Vector2(c.x + l * 0.5, absf(c.z) + w * 0.5).length()
+		if far > r - 1.0:
+			continue   # (off its levelled ground)
+		out.append({"id": out.size() + 1, "at": c, "size": Vector2(l, w), "big": big})
+	return out
+
+
+## The control tower's place (town-local), or null if it's off the level ground.
+static func tower_of(site: Dictionary) -> Variant:
+	var lay := CosmosTown.layout(str(site.get("kind", "village")))
+	var at: Vector3 = (lay["port"] as Vector3) + TOWER
+	if at.length() + 4.5 > float(site.get("r", 130.0)):
+		return null
+	return at
+
+
+## A ship on pad `p` (town-local): its deck's middle, the ship's frame - its nose out along the town's x.
+static func pad_frame(p: Dictionary) -> Transform3D:
+	return Transform3D(Basis(Vector3(0, 0, 1), Vector3(0, 1, 0), Vector3(-1, 0, 0)), p["at"])
+
+
+static func key_of(pl: Node, site: Dictionary, p: Dictionary) -> String:
+	return "%s:%s|%d" % [str(pl.rec.get("id", "")) if pl else "", str(site.get("name", "")), int(p["id"])]
+
+
+# --- The schedule -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Pad `p`'s round `c` (key: key_of): {busy, c, arrive, land, leave, gone (galaxy time), kind
+## (shuttle, trader, courier), hull, empire, seed, pilot (his name), emp_pilot}.
+static func slot(key: String, p: Dictionary, c: int, town_emp: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = hash("%s#%d" % [key, c])
+	var phase := float(absi(hash(key)) % int(CYCLE))
+	var start := c * CYCLE + phase
+	var busy := rng.randf() < BUSY
+	if test_busy >= 0.0:
+		busy = test_busy > 0.5
+	var taken: Dictionary = CosmosGame.extra.get("pads_taken", {})
+	if int(taken.get(key, -999)) == c:
+		busy = false   # (its ship hired off it this round)
+	var arrive := start + rng.randf_range(0.0, 50.0)
+	var land := arrive + APPROACH
+	var leave := land + rng.randf_range(STAY[0], STAY[1])
+	var kind := "courier"
+	if p["big"]:
+		var k := rng.randf()
+		kind = "shuttle" if k < 0.55 else ("trader" if k < 0.88 else "courier")
+	var emp: String = town_emp if rng.randf() < 0.75 or not town_emp in EMPS else str(EMPS[rng.randi() % EMPS.size()])
+	var given: String = People.GIVEN[rng.randi() % People.GIVEN.size()]
+	var family: String = People.FAMILY[rng.randi() % People.FAMILY.size()]
+	return {"busy": busy, "c": c, "arrive": arrive, "land": land, "leave": leave, "gone": leave + LIFT, "kind": kind,
+		"hull": "fighter" if kind == "courier" else "shuttle", "empire": emp, "seed": rng.randi(), "pilot": "%s %s" % [given, family]}
+
+
+## The round of pad `p` going on at galaxy time `time`.
+static func slot_at(key: String, p: Dictionary, time: float, town_emp: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var phase := float(absi(hash(key)) % int(CYCLE))
+	return slot(key, p, floori((time - phase) / CYCLE), town_emp)
+
+
+## The next round (from `time` on) a ship comes down on pad `p`.
+static func next_busy(key: String, p: Dictionary, time: float, town_emp: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var phase := float(absi(hash(key)) % int(CYCLE))
+	var c := floori((time - phase) / CYCLE)
+	for i in 40:
+		var s := slot(key, p, c + i, town_emp)
+		if s["busy"] and float(s["arrive"]) >= time:
+			return s
+	return {}
+
+
+# --- Each frame ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if cosmos == null or not cosmos.get("planets"):
+		return
+	_sim_t += delta
+	if _sim_t < 1.0 / SIM_HZ:
+		return
+	_sim_t = 0.0
+	_meshes()
+	tick()
+
+
+## (Shots, the tour) A ship on pad `p` of `t` now, `since` s after it set out to come down
+## (APPROACH: on the pad; more: its pilot out) - its round moved to now.
+func stage(t: CosmosTown, p: Dictionary, since: float, kind := "shuttle") -> CosmosNpcShip:
+	var key := key_of(t.planet, t.site, p)
+	_drop(key)
+	var s := slot_at(key, p, Galaxy.time, str(t.site.get("empire", ""))).duplicate()
+	var shift := Galaxy.time - since - float(s["arrive"])
+	for k in ["arrive", "land", "leave", "gone"]:
+		s[k] = float(s[k]) + shift
+	s["busy"] = true
+	s["kind"] = kind if p["big"] else "courier"
+	s["hull"] = "fighter" if s["kind"] == "courier" else "shuttle"
+	_launch(key, t, p, s, Galaxy.time)
+	return live[key]["ship"] if live.has(key) else null
+
+
+## The towns near you: their pads' rounds looked at - a ship put in where one's due, taken out past GONE.
+func tick() -> void:
+	var f: Node3D = cosmos.focus() if cosmos.has_method("focus") else null
+	if f == null:
+		return
+	var at := f.global_position
+	var now: float = Galaxy.time
+	var seen := {}
+	for t in _towns():
+		var town: CosmosTown = t
+		var d := town.global_position.distance_to(at)
+		if d > GONE:
+			continue
+		var emp := str(town.site.get("empire", ""))
+		for p in pads_of(town.site):
+			var key := key_of(town.planet, town.site, p)
+			seen[key] = true
+			if live.has(key):
+				_watch(key, d)
+				continue
+			if d > NEAR:
+				continue
+			var s := slot_at(key, p, now, emp)
+			if not s["busy"] or now < float(s["arrive"]) or now >= float(s["gone"]):
+				continue
+			if not CosmosHull.ready(str(s["hull"]), str(s["empire"])):
+				continue   # (its design still being made: next time)
+			if _blocked(town, p):
+				_take(key, int(s["c"]))   # (your ship's on it: this round it goes elsewhere)
+				continue
+			_launch(key, town, p, s, now)
+	for key in live.keys():
+		if not seen.has(key):
+			_drop(key)
+	var taken: Dictionary = CosmosGame.extra.get("pads_taken", {})
+	if taken.size() > 24:   # (old rounds forgotten)
+		for k in taken.keys():
+			if not live.has(k):
+				taken.erase(k)
+
+
+func _towns() -> Array:
+	var out: Array = []
+	var tw = cosmos.get("_towns")
+	if tw == null:
+		return out
+	for list in tw.values():
+		for t in list:
+			if t != null and is_instance_valid(t) and t.is_inside_tree():
+				out.append(t)
+	return out
+
+
+## Your ship on (or over) pad `p` of `t`.
+func _blocked(t: CosmosTown, p: Dictionary) -> bool:
+	var sh: Node3D = cosmos.get("ship")
+	if sh == null or not sh.visible or cosmos.get("ship_elsewhere"):
+		return false
+	var l := t.to_local(sh.global_position)
+	var sz: Vector2 = p["size"]
+	var c: Vector3 = p["at"]
+	return absf(l.x - c.x) < sz.x * 0.5 + 8.0 and absf(l.z - c.z) < sz.y * 0.5 + 8.0 and l.y < 400.0
+
+
+func _take(key: String, c: int) -> void:
+	var taken: Dictionary = CosmosGame.extra.get("pads_taken", {})
+	taken[key] = c
+	CosmosGame.extra["pads_taken"] = taken
+
+
+## A pad's ship flown: in the sky on its way down, down on it, or on its way up - where its round has it now.
+func _launch(key: String, t: CosmosTown, p: Dictionary, s: Dictionary, now: float) -> void:
+	var sh := CosmosNpcShip.new()
+	sh.setup("trader", cosmos, int(s["seed"]), str(s["empire"]), str(s["hull"]))
+	var short := str(Galaxy.EMPIRES.get(str(s["empire"]), {}).get("short", "Independent"))
+	var what := str(s["kind"])
+	sh.label = "%s %s - %s" % [short, what, s["pilot"]]
+	sh.name = "FieldShip"
+	sh.set_meta("field_key", key)
+	sh.set("traffic", self)
+	cosmos.world.add_child(sh)
+	cosmos.npc_ships.append(sh)
+	sh._make_gear()
+	var r := {"ship": sh, "pilot": null, "slot": s, "town": t, "pad": p, "state": "in", "t": 0.0, "near": false}
+	live[key] = r
+	if now >= float(s["leave"]):
+		r["state"] = "up"   # (its pilot back aboard already: lifting off)
+		r["t"] = now - float(s["leave"])
+	elif now >= float(s["land"]):
+		r["state"] = "down"
+		r["t"] = now - float(s["land"])
+		sh._gear_k = 1.0
+		sh._ramp_k = 1.0
+		sh._gear_show()
+		r["ashore"] = r["t"] > 12.0   # (down a while: its pilot's in the town already)
+	fly(sh, 0.0)
+
+
+## Gone back to numbers (its town far, or gone): the ship and its pilot taken out.
+func _drop(key: String) -> void:
+	var r: Dictionary = live.get(key, {})
+	live.erase(key)
+	if r.is_empty():
+		return
+	var s = r["ship"]
+	if is_instance_valid(s) and s.get("traffic") == self:
+		cosmos.npc_ships.erase(s)
+		s.queue_free()
+	_free_pilot(r)
+
+
+func _free_pilot(r: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var x = r.get("pilot")
+	r["pilot"] = null
+	if is_instance_valid(x) and x.get("ride") == null:
+		cosmos.citizens.erase(x)
+		x.queue_free()
+
+
+## Each tick, a pad's ship that's here: its pilot out (near, the ramp down) or back, hired off, gone.
+func _watch(key: String, d: float) -> void:
+	var r: Dictionary = live[key]
+	var s: CosmosNpcShip = r["ship"] if is_instance_valid(r["ship"]) else null
+	if s == null:
+		live.erase(key)   # (shot down, or gone)
+		_free_pilot(r)
+		return
+	if r["state"] == "hired":
+		# (its pilot's yours now: the pad its until it's off it - then free this round)
+		if s.hire.is_empty() or not s.hire_state() in ["wait", "climb"]:
+			live.erase(key)
+		return
+	var t: CosmosTown = r["town"]
+	var x = r["pilot"]
+	if r["state"] == "down" and d < ASHORE and t.built and s._ramp_k > 0.99 and not is_instance_valid(x) and not r.get("back", false):
+		_pilot_out(r, bool(r.get("ashore", false)) or float(r["t"]) > 20.0)   # (down a while before you came near: he's in the town)
+	elif is_instance_valid(x) and d > ASHORE * 1.5 and x.get("_off") == 2:
+		_free_pilot(r)   # (out of the town's reach: one of its numbers again)
+		r["ashore"] = true
+	if r["state"] == "down" and Galaxy.time >= float((r["slot"] as Dictionary)["leave"]):
+		r["state"] = "call"   # (its time up: its pilot back to it)
+		r["t"] = 0.0
+		if is_instance_valid(r["pilot"]):
+			r["pilot"].call("go_back")
+
+
+## Its pilot out: down its ramp (or, it's been down a while, already in the town).
+func _pilot_out(r: Dictionary, ashore: bool) -> void:
+	var t: CosmosTown = r["town"]
+	var s: CosmosNpcShip = r["ship"]
+	var sl: Dictionary = r["slot"]
+	var x := CosmosNpc.new()
+	x.cosmos = cosmos
+	x.citizen_of(t, int(sl["seed"]), "pilot")
+	x.role = "captain"
+	x.label = "%s, pilot of the %s" % [sl["pilot"], str(s.label).get_slice(" - ", 0)]
+	x.name = "FieldPilot"
+	x.set_meta("field_key", key_of(t.planet, t.site, r["pad"]))
+	x.set_meta("courier", sl["kind"] == "courier")
+	x.set_meta("who", str(sl["pilot"]))
+	x.set_meta("pad", int((r["pad"] as Dictionary)["id"]))
+	x.stay_at = _stay_spot(t, int(sl["seed"]))
+	cosmos.world.add_child(x)
+	cosmos.citizens.append(x)
+	r["pilot"] = x
+	if s.interior == null and not ashore:
+		s.make_interior()   # (its doorway cut in its hull, its insides made on a worker)
+	if ashore:
+		x.leave_ship(s, true)
+	else:
+		x.leave_ship(s)
+
+
+## Where a pilot spends his time ashore (town-local): the square (open ground near its
+## middle), a house's door, the palace's colonnade.
+static func _stay_spot(t: CosmosTown, seed: int) -> Vector3:
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = seed
+	var k := rng.randf()
+	if str(t.site.get("kind", "")) == "city" and k < 0.3:
+		return Vector3(-16.6, 0.0, rng.randf_range(-8.0, 8.0))   # (the colonnade before the palace's west wing)
+	if k < 0.6 and not t.doors.is_empty():
+		var dr: Array = t.doors[rng.randi() % t.doors.size()]
+		return (dr[0] as Vector3) + (dr[1] as Vector3) * 1.4
+	if t.spots.is_empty():
+		return t.port + Vector3(-30.0, 0, 0)
+	var near: Array = t.spots.duplicate()
+	near.sort_custom(func(a, b): return Vector2(a.x, a.z).length() < Vector2(b.x, b.z).length())
+	var p: Vector3 = near[rng.randi() % mini(12, near.size())]
+	return Vector3(p.x, 0.0, p.z)
+
+
+# --- Flying them --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## A pad's ship, each frame (CosmosNpcShip._process): where its round has it.
+func fly(s: CosmosNpcShip, delta: float) -> void:
+	var key := str(s.get_meta("field_key", ""))
+	var r: Dictionary = live.get(key, {})
+	if r.is_empty() or not is_instance_valid(r["town"]) or r["ship"] != s:
+		s.set("traffic", null)
+		cosmos.npc_ships.erase(s)
+		s.queue_free()
+		return
+	var t: CosmosTown = r["town"]
+	var p: Dictionary = r["pad"]
+	var sl: Dictionary = r["slot"]
+	var deck := t.global_transform * pad_frame(p)
+	var rest := Transform3D(deck.basis, deck.origin + deck.basis.y * s.rest_height())
+	var u := deck.basis.y
+	var out := t.global_basis.x.normalized()
+	match str(r["state"]):
+		"in":   # (from the sky: in over the town's far side, slowing, down onto the pad)
+			var k := clampf((Galaxy.time - float(sl["arrive"])) / APPROACH, 0.0, 1.0)
+			var from := rest.origin + u * 1500.0 + out * 2600.0
+			var over := rest.origin + u * 90.0
+			var bend := rest.origin + u * 520.0 + out * 380.0
+			if k < 0.72:
+				var q := k / 0.72
+				q = 1.0 - (1.0 - q) * (1.0 - q)   # (fast in, slowing)
+				var a := from.lerp(bend, q)
+				var b := bend.lerp(over, q)
+				var p0 := a.lerp(b, q)
+				var go := (b - a)
+				if go.length() > 0.01:
+					s.global_basis = s.global_basis.slerp(Cosmos._level(go.normalized(), u), minf(1.0, maxf(delta, 0.02) * 2.0)).orthonormalized() if delta > 0.0 else Cosmos._level(go.normalized(), u)
+				s.global_position = p0
+				s._gear_step(0.0, 0.0, delta)
+			else:
+				var q := smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, (k - 0.72) / 0.28)
+				s.global_position = over.lerp(rest.origin, q)
+				s.global_basis = s.global_basis.slerp(rest.basis, minf(1.0, maxf(delta, 0.02) * 1.6)).orthonormalized() if delta > 0.0 else rest.basis
+				s._gear_step(1.0 if q > 0.35 else 0.0, 0.0, delta)
+			s._engines_glow(0.8)
+			if k >= 1.0:
+				s.global_transform = rest
+				r["state"] = "down"
+				r["t"] = 0.0
+				_note(r, "lands at")
+		"down", "call":   # (on the pad, its ramp down: its pilot off into the town, back)
+			r["t"] = float(r["t"]) + delta
+			s.global_transform = rest
+			s._gear_step(1.0, 1.0 if float(r["t"]) > 1.5 or r["state"] == "call" else 0.0, delta)
+			s._engines_glow(0.0)
+			if r["state"] == "call":
+				var x = r["pilot"]
+				var aboard: bool = not is_instance_valid(x) or x.get("_off") == 5
+				var w: Node = cosmos.get("walker")
+				if w and s.interior and w.get("deck") == s.interior:
+					r["t"] = minf(float(r["t"]), 140.0)   # (you aboard, walking round it: it waits till you're down its ramp)
+				elif aboard or float(r["t"]) > 150.0:   # (back aboard - or never coming: off without him)
+					_free_pilot(r)
+					r["state"] = "up"
+					r["t"] = 0.0
+		"up":   # (its ramp up, its legs in once it's off the deck; straight up, then away, climbing)
+			r["t"] = float(r["t"]) + delta
+			var tt: float = r["t"]
+			s._gear_step(1.0 if tt < 4.0 else 0.0, 0.0, delta)
+			var h := 0.0
+			var o := 0.0
+			if tt > 3.0:
+				var v := tt - 3.0
+				h = minf(v, 8.0) * minf(v, 8.0) * 1.9
+				if v > 8.0:
+					var w := v - 8.0
+					h += 30.0 * w + 6.0 * w * w
+					o = 10.0 * w * w
+			var p1 := rest.origin + u * h + out * o
+			var go := p1 - s.global_position
+			if o > 1.0 and go.length() > 0.01:
+				s.global_basis = s.global_basis.slerp(Cosmos._level(go.normalized(), u), minf(1.0, maxf(delta, 0.02) * 0.8)).orthonormalized()
+			elif o <= 1.0:
+				s.global_basis = rest.basis
+			s.global_position = p1
+			s._engines_glow(0.8 if tt > 2.5 else 0.0)
+			if tt > 3.0 and not r.get("off_noted", false):
+				r["off_noted"] = true
+				_note(r, "lifts off from")
+			if tt >= LIFT:
+				live.erase(key)
+				s.set("traffic", null)
+				cosmos.npc_ships.erase(s)
+				s.queue_free()
+
+
+## The event log: what you see come and go (only the ships near you - flown).
+func _note(r: Dictionary, verb: String) -> void:
+	var t: CosmosTown = r["town"]
+	if cosmos and cosmos.has_method("within_news") and is_instance_valid(t) and not cosmos.within_news(t.global_position):
+		return   # (a far town's field: not news - only within 2 km of you)
+	var sl: Dictionary = r["slot"]
+	var what: String = "A " + str(sl["kind"])
+	var who := str(PEOPLE.get(str(sl["empire"]), "Independents"))
+	var text := "%s of the %s %s %s's field (pad %d)" % [what, who, verb, t.site.get("name", "the town"), int((r["pad"] as Dictionary)["id"])]
+	GameLog.post(text, "info")
+
+
+# --- Hired off its pad (CosmosSandbox) ----------------------------------------------------
+
+## The pad's record of pilot `x` (or {}).
+func record_of(x: Node) -> Dictionary:
+	var key := str(x.get_meta("field_key", "")) if x else ""
+	var r: Dictionary = live.get(key, {})
+	return r if not r.is_empty() and r.get("pilot") == x else {}
+
+
+## Pilot `x` hired to `to` (CosmosNpcShip.hire_ride's `to`): his ship no longer
+## the field's - a hired ride waiting on its pad (CosmosNpcShip "wait": he walks back
+## to it and up to its pilot's seat, you after him); the pad free once it's off.
+func hire(x: Node, to: Dictionary) -> CosmosNpcShip:
+	var r := record_of(x)
+	if r.is_empty() or not is_instance_valid(r["ship"]):
+		return null
+	var s: CosmosNpcShip = r["ship"]
+	var t: CosmosTown = r["town"]
+	var key := key_of(t.planet, t.site, r["pad"])
+	_take(key, int((r["slot"] as Dictionary)["c"]))
+	s.set("traffic", null)
+	s.make_interior()
+	s.hire = {"state": "wait", "t": 0.0, "pl": t.planet, "field": t.transform * pad_frame(r["pad"]), "to": to, "pilot": x,
+		"pilot_walk": x.global_position.distance_to(s.global_position) * 1.8 / CosmosNpc.CREW_RUN}   # (waited for while he walks back through the town)
+	s.label = "%s's shuttle" % str(x.get_meta("who", "The pilot"))
+	r["state"] = "hired"
+	r["pilot"] = null   # (his own now: walking to it, aboard)
+	x.call("go_back", true)
+	return s
+
+
+# --- Their meshes -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Each built town's pads made (on a worker) and put in: its deck mesh, its lamps, its solids.
+func _meshes() -> void:
+	for t in _towns():
+		var town: CosmosTown = t
+		if not town.built:
+			_jobs.erase(town)
+			continue
+		if town.has_node("LandingField"):
+			var lf := town.get_node("LandingField")
+			var lit := maxf(town.lit, 0.0)
+			if absf(float(lf.get_meta("lit", -1.0)) - lit) > 0.004:
+				lf.set_meta("lit", lit)
+				for ch in lf.get_children():
+					if ch.name == "Lamps":
+						(ch as MeshInstance3D).set_instance_shader_parameter("lamp_lit", lit)
+			continue
+		var pads := pads_of(town.site)
+		if pads.is_empty():
+			continue
+		if not _jobs.has(town):
+			var site: Dictionary = town.site
+			var job := {"out": {}}
+			job["id"] = Jobs.add(func(): job["out"] = build(site), false, "landing pads")
+			_jobs[town] = job
+			continue
+		var j: Dictionary = _jobs[town]
+		if not Jobs.done(int(j["id"])):
+			continue
+		Jobs.wait(int(j["id"]))
+		_jobs.erase(town)
+		_put_in(town, j["out"])
+
+
+func _exit_tree() -> void:
+	for t in _jobs:
+		Jobs.wait(int(_jobs[t]["id"]))   # (no worker left running)
+	_jobs = {}
+
+
+## A mesh from arrays made on a worker (here, on the main thread); a mesh as it is.
+static func _mesh_of(a) -> Mesh:
+	if a is Mesh:
+		return a
+	var m := ArrayMesh.new()
+	if a is Array and not (a as Array).is_empty() and a[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] != null and (a[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] as PackedVector3Array).size() > 0:
+		m.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, a)
+	return m
+
+
+## The made meshes into the town (a node of their own) and their solids into its own.
+static func _put_in(town: CosmosTown, out: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var lf := Node3D.new()
+	lf.name = "LandingField"
+	var emp := str(town.site.get("empire", ""))
+	var deck := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	deck.name = "Pads"
+	deck.mesh = _mesh_of(out["deck"])
+	deck.material_override = EmpireKit.mat("hull", emp if EmpireKit.LOOKS.has(emp) else "")
+	deck.visibility_range_end = 6000.0
+	lf.add_child(deck)
+	var lamps := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	lamps.name = "Lamps"
+	lamps.mesh = _mesh_of(out["lamps"])
+	lamps.material_override = CosmosTown.material(emp)
+	lamps.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	lamps.visibility_range_end = 6000.0
+	var lit := maxf(town.lit, 0.0) if town.lit >= 0.0 else TownLamps.night_of(town)
+	lamps.set_instance_shader_parameter("lamp_lit", lit)
+	lf.set_meta("lit", lit)
+	lf.add_child(lamps)
+	town.add_child(lf)
+	add_solids(town, out["solids"])
+
+
+## Blocks added to a built town's solids (and its grid's cells).
+static func add_solids(town: CosmosTown, solids: Array) -> void:
+	for b in solids:
+		var i := town._solids.size()
+		town._solids.append(b)
+		var a: AABB = b
+		for gx in range(floori((a.position.x - 1.0) / CosmosSolids.GRID), floori((a.end.x + 1.0) / CosmosSolids.GRID) + 1):
+			for gz in range(floori((a.position.z - 1.0) / CosmosSolids.GRID), floori((a.end.z + 1.0) / CosmosSolids.GRID) + 1):
+				var k := Vector2i(gx, gz)
+				var cell: PackedInt32Array = town._grid.get(k, PackedInt32Array())
+				cell.append(i)
+				town._grid[k] = cell
+
+
+## A town's pads, made (a worker): {deck: mesh arrays (EmpireKit's zones), lamps: mesh arrays
+## (the town shader's lamp slot), solids: [AABB]} - town-local.
+static func build(site: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var m := EmpireKit.Mesher.new()
+	var L := _Lamps.new()
+	var solids: Array = []
+	for p in pads_of(site):
+		var c: Vector3 = p["at"]
+		var sz: Vector2 = p["size"]
+		var hx := sz.x * 0.5
+		var hz := sz.y * 0.5
+		# The deck: a slab of the empire's paint, its kerb dark iron.
+		m.boxat(Vector3(sz.x, DECK + 0.4, sz.y), Vector3(c.x, (DECK - 0.4) * 0.5, c.z), EmpireKit.MAIN)
+		m.boxat(Vector3(sz.x + 0.6, 0.3, sz.y + 0.6), Vector3(c.x, -0.12, c.z), EmpireKit.IRON)
+		var y := DECK + 0.012
+		# The hazard band round it, a line of the accent inside it.
+		for e in 4:
+			var along_x := e < 2
+			var sd := -1.0 if e % 2 == 0 else 1.0
+			if along_x:
+				_strip(m, Vector3(c.x, y, c.z + sd * (hz - 1.1)), Vector2(sz.x - 1.2, 1.0), EmpireKit.HAZARD)
+				_strip(m, Vector3(c.x, y, c.z + sd * (hz - 2.6)), Vector2(sz.x - 4.2, 0.35), EmpireKit.ACCENT)
+			else:
+				_strip(m, Vector3(c.x + sd * (hx - 1.1), y, c.z), Vector2(1.0, sz.y - 4.2), EmpireKit.HAZARD)
+				_strip(m, Vector3(c.x + sd * (hx - 2.6), y, c.z), Vector2(0.35, sz.y - 4.9), EmpireKit.ACCENT)
+		# The roundel (its emblem) in its middle; a chevron at its nose end (the town's x: out).
+		m.disc(Vector3(c.x, y + 0.006, c.z), Vector3.UP, Vector3(-1, 0, 0), minf(hx, hz) * 0.42, EmpireKit.ROUNDEL, 28)
+		var nose := c.x + hx - 4.6
+		for sd in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+			var a := Vector3(nose, y + 0.004, c.z)
+			var b := Vector3(nose - 2.6, y + 0.004, c.z + sd * 3.0)
+			var dir := (b - a).normalized()
+			var side := Vector3(-dir.z, 0, dir.x) * 0.45
+			m.quad(a - side, b - side, b + side, a + side, EmpireKit.ACCENT, Vector3(c.x, -1.0, c.z))
+		# Its lamps: a glowing line just in from each edge, a lamp in housings at its corners and along its sides.
+		for e in 4:
+			var along_x := e < 2
+			var sd := -1.0 if e % 2 == 0 else 1.0
+			if along_x:
+				L.strip(Vector3(c.x, y + 0.004, c.z + sd * (hz - 0.3)), Vector2(sz.x - 0.6, 0.22))
+			else:
+				L.strip(Vector3(c.x + sd * (hx - 0.3), y + 0.004, c.z), Vector2(0.22, sz.y - 0.6))
+		for ex in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+			for ez in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+				var q := Vector3(c.x + ex * (hx + 0.7), 0.0, c.z + ez * (hz + 0.7))
+				m.boxat(Vector3(0.7, 0.36, 0.7), q + Vector3(0, 0.18, 0), EmpireKit.IRON)
+				L.box(q + Vector3(0, 0.36, 0), Vector3(0.42, 0.2, 0.42))
+		solids.append(AABB(Vector3(c.x - hx, -0.4, c.z - hz), Vector3(sz.x, DECK + 0.4, sz.y)))
+	var tw = tower_of(site)
+	if tw != null:
+		_tower(m, L, tw as Vector3, solids)
+	return {"deck": m.arrays(), "lamps": L.arrays(), "solids": solids}   # (arrays: their meshes made on the main thread - meshes made on workers race in the renderer)
+
+
+## A flat band on the deck (its middle, its size x by z), facing up.
+static func _strip(m: EmpireKit.Mesher, mid: Vector3, size: Vector2, zone: int) -> void:
+	var hx := size.x * 0.5
+	var hz := size.y * 0.5
+	m.quad(mid + Vector3(-hx, 0, -hz), mid + Vector3(hx, 0, -hz), mid + Vector3(hx, 0, hz), mid + Vector3(-hx, 0, hz), zone, mid - Vector3.UP)
+
+
+## The field's control tower at `at` (its foot): a plinth, a shaft (the roundel on it),
+## the glazed cab (lit by night), its roof, the mast and its beacon.
+static func _tower(m: EmpireKit.Mesher, L, at: Vector3, solids: Array) -> void:
+	m.boxat(Vector3(6.4, 0.8, 6.4), at + Vector3(0, 0.4, 0), EmpireKit.IRON)
+	m.boxat(Vector3(4.0, 8.6, 4.0), at + Vector3(0, 0.8 + 4.3, 0), EmpireKit.MAIN)
+	m.boxat(Vector3(4.3, 0.5, 4.3), at + Vector3(0, 9.15, 0), EmpireKit.ACCENT)
+	for sd in [-1.0, 1.0]:   # (the roundel toward the field and away)
+		m.disc(at + Vector3(sd * 2.02, 5.2, 0), Vector3(sd, 0, 0), Vector3.UP, 1.5, EmpireKit.ROUNDEL, 24)
+	m.boxat(Vector3(7.0, 0.4, 7.0), at + Vector3(0, 9.6, 0), EmpireKit.IRON)   # (the cab's floor)
+	for ex in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+		for ez in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+			m.boxat(Vector3(0.35, 2.8, 0.35), at + Vector3(ex * 3.3, 11.2, ez * 3.3), EmpireKit.STEEL)
+	m.boxat(Vector3(6.4, 0.6, 6.4), at + Vector3(0, 10.1, 0), EmpireKit.MAIN)   # (under its windows)
+	L.box(at + Vector3(0, 11.4, 0), Vector3(6.3, 2.0, 6.3))   # (its windows: lit within by night)
+	m.boxat(Vector3(7.6, 0.45, 7.6), at + Vector3(0, 12.8, 0), EmpireKit.ACCENT)   # (its roof)
+	m.boxat(Vector3(7.8, 0.12, 7.8), at + Vector3(0, 13.08, 0), EmpireKit.GOLD)
+	m.cyl(at + Vector3(0, 13.1, 0), at + Vector3(0, 17.0, 0), 0.14, 0.1, EmpireKit.STEEL, 8)
+	m.boxat(Vector3(0.6, 0.6, 0.6), at + Vector3(0, 17.2, 0), EmpireKit.LAMP)   # (its beacon: always lit)
+	solids.append(AABB(at - Vector3(3.2, 0, 3.2), Vector3(6.4, 0.8, 6.4)))
+	solids.append(AABB(at + Vector3(-2.0, 0.8, -2.0), Vector3(4.0, 12.4, 4.0)))
+	solids.append(AABB(at + Vector3(-3.8, 9.4, -3.8), Vector3(7.6, 3.7, 7.6)))
+
+
+## The lamps' faces (the town shader's slot 14 - lit by night - its flame unmoved: no rise).
+class _Lamps:
+	var verts := PackedVector3Array()
+	var norms := PackedVector3Array()
+	var idx := PackedInt32Array()
+
+	func quad(a: Vector3, b: Vector3, c: Vector3, d: Vector3, n: Vector3) -> void:
+		var base := verts.size()
+		verts.append_array([a, b, c, d])
+		for k in 4:
+			norms.append(n)
+		if (b - a).cross(c - a).dot(n) > 0.0:   # (Godot's front faces wind clockwise)
+			idx.append_array([base, base + 2, base + 1, base, base + 3, base + 2])
+		else:
+			idx.append_array([base, base + 1, base + 2, base, base + 2, base + 3])
+
+	func strip(mid: Vector3, size: Vector2) -> void:
+		var hx := size.x * 0.5
+		var hz := size.y * 0.5
+		quad(mid + Vector3(-hx, 0, -hz), mid + Vector3(hx, 0, -hz), mid + Vector3(hx, 0, hz), mid + Vector3(-hx, 0, hz), Vector3.UP)
+
+	func box(mid: Vector3, size: Vector3) -> void:
+		var h := size * 0.5
+		var p := [mid + Vector3(-h.x, -h.y, -h.z), mid + Vector3(h.x, -h.y, -h.z), mid + Vector3(h.x, -h.y, h.z), mid + Vector3(-h.x, -h.y, h.z),
+			mid + Vector3(-h.x, h.y, -h.z), mid + Vector3(h.x, h.y, -h.z), mid + Vector3(h.x, h.y, h.z), mid + Vector3(-h.x, h.y, h.z)]
+		quad(p[4], p[5], p[6], p[7], Vector3.UP)
+		quad(p[0], p[1], p[5], p[4], Vector3.FORWARD)
+		quad(p[2], p[3], p[7], p[6], Vector3.BACK)
+		quad(p[1], p[2], p[6], p[5], Vector3.RIGHT)
+		quad(p[3], p[0], p[4], p[7], Vector3.LEFT)
+
+	func mesh() -> ArrayMesh:
+		var mm := ArrayMesh.new()
+		mm.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, arrays())
+		return mm
+
+	func arrays() -> Array:
+		var arr := []
+		arr.resize(Mesh.ARRAY_MAX)
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] = verts
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL] = norms
+		var cols := PackedColorArray()
+		cols.resize(verts.size())
+		cols.fill(Color(14.0 / 255.0, 0.0, 0.0))   # (slot 14, its rise 0: lit by night where it stands)
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_COLOR] = cols
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX] = idx
+		return arr

files.explanation: New: the mushroom mammoth's own model and motion: a skinned mesh of body, head, trunk, tusks, ears, legs, tail and the fungus on its back, made once on a worker with its levels of detail, and a 31-bone rig that walks it with planted feet and has it graze, fan its ears, rest, throw dust and trumpet.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,904 @@ 
+class_name CosmosMammoth
+extends RefCounted
+## The mushroom mammoth (CosmosFauna "mykelephas", kind "model": "mammoth") - a
+## towering, calm grazer with a fungus growing from its back; its own model and
+## motion, not the generic heavy kit: one shared skinned mesh (one surface, one
+## draw call, a lower LOD for far off; made on a worker like the fox's) over a
+## 31-bone rig each mammoth builds for itself (Rig):
+##  - a massive body (a high domed shoulder, the back sloping to the rump, a
+##    heavy hanging belly), thick pillar legs on broad round feet with toenails,
+##    a big head with a domed skull, small deep-set eyes in wrinkled lids, large
+##    fan ears, a long trunk (six bones) ending in a finger, curved tusks out,
+##    down and up, a short tail with a tuft of coarse hair;
+##  - the fungus: a stout stalk rising from the spine with a ring on it, a
+##    broad domed cap with a wavy rolled rim, gills under it, warts over it (c2),
+##    and small mushrooms sprouting from the shoulders and back;
+##  - the skin (mammoth.gdshader): thick, cracked into plates, folded at the
+##    joints and ringed along the trunk (bumped in the shader from the rest
+##    position - CUSTOM0), mottled, sparse coarse hair, mud and dust low on the
+##    legs, a little light through the ears; the cap moist, warted, gilled.
+##    COLOR: r - 0..0.2 fungus (amount), 0.4 a toenail, 0.6 a tusk, 0.8 an eye;
+##    g - a fold's strength on skin, the fungus's part (0 stalk, 0.5 gills, 1 the
+##    cap), along a tusk, an eye's depth; b - thin / pink (ears, the trunk's tip,
+##    the lip); a - hair.
+## Rig.step() moves it: the walk a lateral-sequence four-beat gait (each hind
+## foot, then the fore on its side), an amble when it hurries (no moment off the
+## ground), the feet planted (each leg reaches its foot by IK; the body rises
+## over the stance legs and sinks between them, swaying from side to side), the
+## head nodding, the ears fanning slowly, the trunk swinging with the stride and
+## the cap jiggling on its stalk; standing, it grazes (the trunk feeling over
+## the ground, curling a mouthful up to its mouth, the jaw chewing), fans its
+## ears, rests a hind leg, throws dust over its back, looks round, swishes its
+## tail; hurt, it trumpets. Unit space (y up from the ground, forward -z);
+## CosmosCreature scales it by the species' size.
+
+const SHADER := preload("res://shaders/world/mammoth.gdshader")
+
+## The bones: [name, parent, rest position (unit space, global)].
+const BONES := [
+	["pelvis", -1, Vector3(0, 1.2, 0.5)],
+	["chest", 0, Vector3(0, 1.25, -0.35)],
+	["neck", 1, Vector3(0, 1.36, -0.66)],
+	["head", 2, Vector3(0, 1.46, -0.92)],
+	["jaw", 3, Vector3(0, 1.22, -1.0)],
+	["ear_l", 3, Vector3(-0.22, 1.5, -0.86)],
+	["ear_l2", 5, Vector3(-0.33, 1.42, -0.64)],
+	["ear_r", 3, Vector3(0.22, 1.5, -0.86)],
+	["ear_r2", 7, Vector3(0.33, 1.42, -0.64)],
+	["trunk0", 3, Vector3(0, 1.3, -1.19)],
+	["trunk1", 9, Vector3(0, 1.1, -1.27)],
+	["trunk2", 10, Vector3(0, 0.9, -1.3)],
+	["trunk3", 11, Vector3(0, 0.7, -1.31)],
+	["trunk4", 12, Vector3(0, 0.51, -1.3)],
+	["trunk5", 13, Vector3(0, 0.34, -1.28)],
+	["tail0", 0, Vector3(0, 1.2, 1.02)],
+	["tail1", 15, Vector3(0, 0.95, 1.08)],
+	["cap", 0, Vector3(0, 1.42, 0.08)],
+	["cap_top", 17, Vector3(0, 1.84, 0.08)],
+	["fl_up", 1, Vector3(-0.29, 1.18, -0.45)],
+	["fl_low", 19, Vector3(-0.3, 0.7, -0.4)],
+	["fl_foot", 20, Vector3(-0.3, 0.19, -0.46)],
+	["fr_up", 1, Vector3(0.29, 1.18, -0.45)],
+	["fr_low", 22, Vector3(0.3, 0.7, -0.4)],
+	["fr_foot", 23, Vector3(0.3, 0.19, -0.46)],
+	["hl_up", 0, Vector3(-0.28, 1.12, 0.6)],
+	["hl_low", 25, Vector3(-0.29, 0.62, 0.52)],
+	["hl_foot", 26, Vector3(-0.29, 0.19, 0.64)],
+	["hr_up", 0, Vector3(0.28, 1.12, 0.6)],
+	["hr_low", 28, Vector3(0.29, 0.62, 0.52)],
+	["hr_foot", 29, Vector3(0.29, 0.19, 0.64)],
+]
+enum { PELVIS, CHEST, NECK, HEAD, JAW, EAR_L, EAR_L2, EAR_R, EAR_R2,
+	TRUNK0, TRUNK1, TRUNK2, TRUNK3, TRUNK4, TRUNK5, TAIL0, TAIL1, CAP, CAP_TOP,
+	FL_UP, FL_LOW, FL_FOOT, FR_UP, FR_LOW, FR_FOOT, HL_UP, HL_LOW, HL_FOOT, HR_UP, HR_LOW, HR_FOOT }
+## Where the ankles stand (unit space height) - the soles flat on the ground under them.
+const ANKLE_Y := 0.19
+## Its bulk for the camera and shots (unit space): the body, the head - [centre, radii].
+const BULK := [[Vector3(0, 1.12, 0.1), Vector3(0.5, 0.48, 0.98)], [Vector3(0, 1.45, -0.98), Vector3(0.3, 0.32, 0.32)]]
+
+static var _mesh: ArrayMesh
+static var _skin: Skin
+static var _task := -1
+static var _built: Builder
+## What the last build made (the tests read it).
+static var made := {}
+
+
+static func start() -> void:
+	if _mesh != null or _task >= 0:
+		return
+	_built = Builder.new()
+	_task = WorkerThreadPool.add_task(_built.run, false, "mammoth mesh")
+
+
+static func is_ready() -> bool:
+	return _mesh != null or (_task >= 0 and WorkerThreadPool.is_task_completed(_task))
+
+
+static func mesh() -> ArrayMesh:
+	if _mesh == null:
+		start()
+		WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(_task)
+		_task = -1
+		var b := _built
+		var m := ArrayMesh.new()
+		var fmt := Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM_RGB_FLOAT << Mesh.ARRAY_FORMAT_CUSTOM0_SHIFT
+		m.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, b.arrays, [], b.lods, fmt)
+		m.custom_aabb = AABB(Vector3(-1.6, -0.3, -2.4), Vector3(3.2, 2.9, 3.9))   # (the trunk raised, the ears spread)
+		made = {"legs": b.legs, "toenails": b.nails, "tusks": b.tusks, "ears": b.ears, "eyes": b.eyes, "trunk_rings": b.trunk_rings,
+			"cap_sides": b.cap_sides, "growths": b.growths, "tuft": b.tuft, "tris": b.body.idx.size() / 3, "verts": b.body.v.size(),
+			"lods": b.lods.size(), "lod_tris": b.lod_tris, "build_ms": b.ms}
+		_built = null
+		_mesh = m
+	return _mesh
+
+
+## The skin binding the mesh to a rig (shared).
+static func skin() -> Skin:
+	if _skin == null:
+		_skin = Skin.new()
+		for i in BONES.size():
+			_skin.add_bind(i, Transform3D(Basis(), -(BONES[i][2] as Vector3)))
+	return _skin
+
+
+static func material(c1: Color, c2: Color) -> ShaderMaterial:
+	var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	m.shader = SHADER
+	m.set_shader_parameter("c1", c1)
+	m.set_shader_parameter("c2", c2)
+	m.set_shader_parameter("noise_tex", Cosmos.noise_ready())
+	return m
+
+
+## A mammoth's skeleton (its bones at rest).
+static func skeleton() -> Skeleton3D:
+	var sk := Skeleton3D.new()
+	for i in BONES.size():
+		var b: Array = BONES[i]
+		sk.add_bone(b[0])
+		var p: int = b[1]
+		var at: Vector3 = b[2]
+		if p >= 0:
+			sk.set_bone_parent(i, p)
+			at -= BONES[p][2] as Vector3
+		sk.set_bone_rest(i, Transform3D(Basis(), at))
+	sk.reset_bone_poses()
+	return sk
+
+
+static func rig(sk: Skeleton3D, seed: int) -> Rig:
+	return Rig.new(sk, seed)
+
+
+## A point `at` (local to the creature, metres) against its bulk: how far along
+## the ray o + dir * s (s up to `limit`) it enters the body or the head, or INF.
+## `size`: metres a unit.
+static func ray_hit(o: Vector3, dir: Vector3, limit: float, size: float) -> float:
+	var best := INF
+	for e: Array in BULK:
+		var c: Vector3 = (e[0] as Vector3) * size
+		var r: Vector3 = (e[1] as Vector3) * size
+		var lo := (o - c) / r
+		var ld := dir / r
+		var a := ld.dot(ld)
+		var bq := lo.dot(ld)
+		var cq := lo.dot(lo) - 1.0
+		var disc := bq * bq - a * cq
+		if disc < 0.0:
+			continue
+		var s := (-bq - sqrt(disc)) / a
+		if cq < 0.0:
+			s = 0.0   # (starting inside)
+		if s >= 0.0 and s < limit:
+			best = minf(best, s)
+	return best
+
+
+## The mesh's vertices with their bones and weights, and each one's rest place (CUSTOM0: the skin's detail).
+class MamPart extends CosmosFox.FoxPart:
+	var rest := PackedFloat32Array()
+	var seams := PackedInt32Array()   # (pairs: a ring's first and last vertex - one normal)
+
+	func arrays() -> Array:
+		var n := PackedVector3Array()
+		n.resize(v.size())
+		for i in range(0, idx.size(), 3):
+			var a := idx[i]
+			var b := idx[i + 1]
+			var c := idx[i + 2]
+			var f := (v[c] - v[a]).cross(v[b] - v[a])
+			n[a] += f
+			n[b] += f
+			n[c] += f
+		for k in range(0, seams.size(), 2):
+			var s := n[seams[k]] + n[seams[k + 1]]
+			n[seams[k]] = s
+			n[seams[k + 1]] = s

+## One mammoth's rig and its motion.

+	var t := 0.0

+	var moving := 0.0
+	var stride := 0.6

+	var act_t := 0.0
+	var look := 0.0
+	var look_to := 0.0
+	var graze := 0.0
+	var graze_t := 0.0
+	var fan := 0.1
+	var ear_ph := 0.0
+	var rest_w := 0.0
+	var rest_side := 1.0
+	var dust := 0.0
+	var dust_t := 0.0

+	var alarm_w := 0.0
+	var tail_t := 0.0
+	var tail_flick := 0.0

+	var cap_v := Vector2.ZERO

+	var jig_v := 0.0

+	var lift_f := 0.0
+	var last_lift := 0.0

+	var _owed := 0.0               # (time not yet posed: a giant's slow motion posed at most 60 times a second)
+	const POSE_DT := 1.0 / 60.0

+	func _init(s: Skeleton3D, seed: int) -> void:

+		phase = rng.randf()
+		graze_t = rng.randf() * 5.0

+	## (it never leaps)

+
+	func leap_height() -> float:

+	## Its call when hurt: the trunk up, the ears spread, the head raised.

+	## One frame: `v` its speed (m/s), `size` its scale (m a unit), `idle` standing about, `alarm` upset (fleeing, charging).

+		_owed = 0.0
+		t += delta
+		var vu := v / maxf(size, 0.05)
+		var k := 1.0 - exp(-delta * 3.0)
+		var amb := smoothstep(0.4, 0.55, vu)
+		gait = gait.lerp(Vector3(1.0 - amb, amb, 0.0), k)
+		moving = lerpf(moving, clampf(vu / 0.08, 0.0, 1.0), 1.0 - exp(-delta * 2.0))
+		stride = lerpf(stride, clampf(0.4 + vu * 1.0, 0.45, 1.2), k)
+		phase = fmod(phase + delta * vu / stride, 1.0)
+		# Standing about: its acts.
+		if idle and vu < 0.04:
+			act_t -= delta
+			if act_t <= 0.0:
+				var r := rng.randf()
+				act = "graze" if r < 0.45 else ("look" if r < 0.58 else ("fan" if r < 0.73 else ("rest" if r < 0.86 else ("dust" if r < 0.95 else "stand"))))
+				act_t = rng.randf_range(7.0, 14.0) if act == "graze" else rng.randf_range(3.5, 7.0)

+	func _q(x: float, y := 0.0, z := 0.0) -> Quaternion:

+	func _rot(b: int, x: float, y := 0.0, z := 0.0) -> void:

+	## A leg's foot at its cycle point `p`: [ankle offset (y lift, z), the foot's pitch, in stance].
+	func _foot(p: float, front: bool) -> Array:

+	## Two-bone IK: the leg from bone `up` reaching its ankle to `target` (skeleton
+	## space), the knee or elbow bent toward `pole`, the foot turned to `pitch`.
+	func _ik(up: int, parent_g: Transform3D, target: Vector3, pole: Vector3, pitch: float) -> void:

+		var b_rest: Vector3 = BONES[up + 1][2]
+		var c_rest: Vector3 = BONES[up + 2][2]
+		var par_rest: Vector3 = BONES[BONES[up][1]][2]
+		var a := parent_g * (a_rest - par_rest)
+		var l1 := (b_rest - a_rest).length()
+		var l2 := (c_rest - b_rest).length()
+		var to := target - a
+		var d := clampf(to.length(), absf(l1 - l2) + 0.001, (l1 + l2) * 0.9995)
+		var u := to.normalized()
+		var w := (pole - u * pole.dot(u)).normalized()

+		var b := a + (u * ca + w * sqrt(1.0 - ca * ca)) * l1
+		var c := a + u * d
+		var r1 := Quaternion((b_rest - a_rest).normalized(), (b - a).normalized())
+		var r2 := Quaternion((c_rest - b_rest).normalized(), (c - b).normalized())

+		sk.set_bone_pose_rotation(up + 1, r1.inverse() * r2)
+		sk.set_bone_pose_rotation(up + 2, r2.inverse() * _q(pitch))

+	## How high a hip can stand over a foot `dz` before or behind it (unit space; 0 at rest).

files.explanation: New: the plants' levels of detail and reach. Each tree or shrub species has a chain of meshes down to a low version and a baked impostor; the shader picks the level per plant by distance over size and blends neighbours with a dither, and the quadtree carries the plants so forests are drawn to the horizon without popping.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,724 @@ 
+class_name FloraLods
+extends RefCounted
+## The plants' levels of detail and their reach (CosmosFlora's meshes,
+## CosmosPlanet's patches): the forests and the maquis drawn out to the
+## horizon, each plant at the detail its size on screen needs.
+##
+## A chain of meshes a species, from every branch and leaf down to a handful
+## of triangles: near (twigs and leaf cards), mid (clumps fringed with cards),
+## far (coarse clumps), low (a few lobes and a trunk - made here from the far
+## mesh: its leaves clustered into ellipsoids) and the impostor (three crossed
+## cards and one across the top - the far mesh drawn into an atlas here, on the
+## design's worker, from the side and from above). Which one draws a plant is
+## chosen per plant, every frame, in the shader (flora.gdshaderinc): its
+## distance over its size (`size_m`) - so a big plane tree keeps its leaves
+## further than a small olive - through the bands LOD_K; next to a band's edge
+## both meshes draw, each a complementary dither of the screen's pixels, so one
+## melts into the next. Which plants each mesh is handed is CosmosPlanet's near
+## field (gathered round the camera on a worker); the patches draw the impostors.
+##
+## Reach: every plant has a distance it fades out by (a dither too). Near, all
+## of them; further, a share falling as 1 / distance (D0) - a forest stays a
+## forest to the horizon at a fraction of the plants. The quadtree carries them:
+## each patch (from level `top` down) owns the plants whose reach falls in its
+## band (LEVEL_REACH x its size - beyond where its children take over, short of
+## where its parent does), and hands them down - a patch's plants are its
+## parent's (those on it) and its own. So a patch and its children draw the
+## same plants where both could be seen: nothing appears or jumps when the
+## ground refines. Coarse patches set each plant on their own (coarse) ground.
+##   FloraLods.chain(sp)                       # (CosmosFlora._species) sp["lods"], "low", "h", "reach"
+##   var atlas := FloraLods.bake(species)      # the impostors: {image, grid}, sp["imp"]
+##   FloraLods.own(...) / inherit(...) / build(...)   # (CosmosPlanet's workers)
+
+## Levels, their bands (distance / the plant's size): near, near thinned (its
+## leaf cards dropped one by one to KEEP of them), mid, far, low, impostor - the
+## thinned level's mesh what the near one has become by its end.
+const LOD_K := [0.0, 2.0, 3.5, 7.0, 16.0, 34.0]
+const LOD_T := 0.4             # (the blend: this many levels wide round each edge - leaf by leaf, flora.gdshaderinc)
+const IMP := 5                 # (the impostor's level: LOD_K.size() - 1)
+const KEEP := 0.25             # (the thinned levels: this share of the leaf cards - those ranked lowest)
+const D0 := 120.0              # m: every plant drawn this near; beyond, D0 / distance of them
+const TREE_REACH := 3500.0     # m: the furthest trees
+const BUSH_REACH := 320.0
+const OTHER_REACH := 900.0     # (crystals, fungi, cacti)
+const LEVEL_REACH := 2.6       # a patch's plants reach this many of its sizes at most
+const CELL := 64               # px: an impostor's view in the atlas
+const COLS := 8
+const REC := 15                # floats a plant record: a, b, dir xyz, h, sink, sc, turn, lean xz, squash xyz, reach
+const LOW_SPRAY := 1.6         # (an ellipsoid's radii: this many of its points' spread)
+
+
+static func is_stand(sp: Dictionary) -> bool:
+	return not (str(sp["kind"]) in ["grass", "flower"])
+
+
+## The share of plants drawn at `d` m.
+static func share(d: float) -> float:
+	return 1.0 if d <= D0 else D0 / d
+
+
+## The continuous level at `x` = distance / size (the shader's lod_t).
+static func lod_t(x: float) -> float:
+	for k in range(LOD_K.size() - 1, -1, -1):
+		if x >= float(LOD_K[k]):
+			var w: float = (float(LOD_K[k + 1]) - float(LOD_K[k])) if k + 1 < LOD_K.size() else float(LOD_K[k])
+			return k + (x - float(LOD_K[k])) / w
+	return 0.0
+
+
+## The distance / size at level `t` (lod_t's inverse).
+static func x_of(t: float) -> float:
+	var k := clampi(int(floor(t)), 0, LOD_K.size() - 1)
+	var w: float = (float(LOD_K[k + 1]) - float(LOD_K[k])) if k + 1 < LOD_K.size() else float(LOD_K[k])
+	return maxf(float(LOD_K[k]) + (t - k) * w, 0.0)
+
+
+## The distances / size the meshes of levels lo..hi draw at, their blends either side included.
+static func band_x(lo: int, hi: int) -> Vector2:
+	return Vector2(0.0 if lo == 0 else x_of(lo - LOD_T * 0.5), INF if hi + 1 >= LOD_K.size() else x_of(hi + 1 + LOD_T * 0.5))
+
+
+## The level drawn at `x` (no crossfade): 0 near .. 4 impostor.
+static func level_at(x: float) -> int:
+	return mini(int(lod_t(x)), LOD_K.size() - 1)
+
+
+# --- The chain -------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## (Worker) A species' chain of meshes: sp["lods"] = [[arrays, lo, hi], ...] (the
+## bands each draws - their COLOR.a says so to the shader), its low mesh, its
+## size (m, for the bands) and how far it's seen.
+static func chain(sp: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var mid: Array = sp["arrays"]
+	var far: Array = sp["far"]
+	var has_far := not is_same(far, mid) and (far[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX] as PackedInt32Array).size() < (mid[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX] as PackedInt32Array).size()
+	var low := _low(far)
+	var has_low := (low[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX] as PackedInt32Array).size() < (far[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX] as PackedInt32Array).size() * 0.8
+	var out: Array = []
+	# near (0) -> near thinned (1) -> mid (2) -> far (3) -> low (4); a mesh without
+	# leaf cards (or a level it lacks) covers the next level too.
+	var seed := hash(str(sp["design"]))
+	var lv := 0
+	if sp.has("near"):
+		lv = _thinning(out, _ranked(sp["near"], seed), 0)
+	var mhi := 2 if has_far else 3
+	out.append([_band(mid, lv, mhi), lv, mhi])
+	lv = mhi + 1
+	if has_far:
+		out.append([_band(far, lv, 3), lv, 3])
+		lv = 4
+	if has_low:
+		out.append([_band(low, lv, 4), lv, 4])
+	else:
+		var last: Array = out.pop_back()
+		out.append([_band(last[0], last[1], 4), last[1], 4])
+	sp["lods"] = out
+	sp["low"] = low
+	var b := _bounds(far)
+	sp["h"] = maxf(b.y, b.x * 1.4)   # (its size on screen: the larger of its height and (most of) its spread)
+	var kind := str(sp["kind"])
+	sp["reach"] = TREE_REACH if kind in ["tree", "spire"] else BUSH_REACH if kind == "bush" else OTHER_REACH
+
+
+## A mesh and its thinned self in the chain from level `lv` (to `top` at most for
+## the thinned one: level lv + 1 by default): the full mesh's cards drop out by
+## rank over its last level (flora.gdshaderinc), the thinned one holds the KEEP
+## lowest-ranked - what the full one has become by then. No cards: one mesh for
+## both levels. Returns the next level.
+static func _thinning(out: Array, arr: Array, lv: int, top := -1) -> int:
+	var hi := lv + 1 if top < 0 else top
+	var thin := _thinned(arr)
+	if thin.is_empty():
+		out.append([_band(arr, lv, hi), lv, hi])
+		return hi + 1
+	var full_hi := hi - 1
+	out.append([_band(arr, lv, full_hi, true), lv, full_hi])
+	out.append([_band(thin, full_hi + 1, hi), full_hi + 1, hi])
+	return hi + 1
+
+
+## The leaf cards (4 vertices each, UV2.x > 2.5 - CosmosFlora.M.card) ranked at
+## random (seeded): the rank in UV2.y (- 16 x floor(rank x 64), under the card's
+## own code) - the shader drops the highest first.
+static func _ranked(arr: Array, seed: int) -> Array:
+	var o := arr.duplicate()
+	var uv2: PackedVector2Array = (arr[Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV2] as PackedVector2Array).duplicate()
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = seed
+	var i := 0
+	while i < uv2.size():
+		if uv2[i].x > 2.5 and uv2[i].x < 6.5 and uv2[i].y > -15.5:
+			var k := floori(rng.randf() * 64.0)
+			for j in 4:
+				if i + j < uv2.size():
+					uv2[i + j].y -= 16.0 * k
+			i += 4
+		else:
+			i += 1
+	o[Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV2] = uv2
+	return o
+
+
+## The ranked arrays with only the cards ranked under KEEP ([] : no cards in it).
+static func _thinned(arr: Array) -> Array:
+	var uv2: PackedVector2Array = arr[Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV2]
+	var ix: PackedInt32Array = arr[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX]
+	var out := PackedInt32Array()
+	var cards := 0
+	for t in range(0, ix.size(), 3):
+		var u := uv2[ix[t]]
+		if u.x > 2.5 and u.x < 6.5:
+			cards += 1
+			if rank_of(u.y) >= KEEP:
+				continue
+		out.append_array([ix[t], ix[t + 1], ix[t + 2]])
+	if cards == 0:
+		return []
+	var o := arr.duplicate()
+	o[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX] = out
+	return o
+
+
+## A card's rank (0..1) from its UV2.y.
+static func rank_of(y: float) -> float:
+	return floor((-y - 1.0) / 16.0) / 64.0
+
+
+## The arrays again, COLOR.a saying the levels it draws and whether its cards thin
+## out over its last: (thin x 64 + lo x 8 + hi + 0.5) / 128.
+static func _band(arr: Array, lo: int, hi: int, thin := false) -> Array:
+	var o := arr.duplicate()
+	var c: PackedColorArray = (arr[Mesh.ARRAY_COLOR] as PackedColorArray).duplicate()
+	var a := ((64 if thin else 0) + lo * 8 + hi + 0.5) / 128.0
+	for i in c.size():
+		c[i].a = a
+	o[Mesh.ARRAY_COLOR] = c
+	return o
+
+
+## Its spread (radius) and height.
+static func _bounds(arr: Array) -> Vector2:
+	var r := 0.1
+	var h := 0.1
+	for p: Vector3 in (arr[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] as PackedVector3Array):
+		r = maxf(r, Vector2(p.x, p.z).length())
+		h = maxf(h, p.y)
+	return Vector2(r, h)
+
+
+## The low mesh: the far mesh's leaves clustered (a few ellipsoids, each its
+## leaves' colour, shaded as one crown) on a five-sided trunk. Plants without
+## leaves: all of it clustered.
+static func _low(far: Array) -> Array:
+	var vs: PackedVector3Array = far[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX]
+	var cs: PackedColorArray = far[Mesh.ARRAY_COLOR]
+	var uv: PackedVector2Array = far[Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV]
+	var uv2: PackedVector2Array = far[Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV2]
+	var leaf := PackedInt32Array()
+	var wood := PackedInt32Array()
+	for i in vs.size():
+		if uv2[i].x > 0.5:
+			leaf.append(i)
+		else:
+			wood.append(i)
+	var leafy := leaf.size() >= 12
+	if not leafy:
+		leaf = PackedInt32Array(range(vs.size()))
+		wood = PackedInt32Array()
+	var m := CosmosFlora.M.new()
+	# (its sway: as the far mesh's - UV.y over height)
+	var sy := 0.0
+	var hy := 0.0
+	for i in vs.size():
+		sy += uv[i].y
+		hy += maxf(vs[i].y, 0.0)
+	m.sway = sy / hy if hy > 0.01 else 0.0
+	var k := clampi(leaf.size() / 25, 3, 6)
+	var km := _kmeans(vs, leaf, k)
+	var cl := _clusters(vs, cs, uv, leaf, km[1], km[0])
+	var crown := Vector3.ZERO
+	for i in leaf:
+		crown += vs[i]
+	crown /= maxf(leaf.size(), 1)
+	var bottom := INF
+	m.leaf = 1.0 if leafy else 0.0
+	var ico: Array = CosmosFlora._ico_cached(0)
+	for c: Array in cl:
+		var cen: Vector3 = c[0]
+		var r: Vector3 = c[1]
+		var col: Color = c[2]
+		m.glow = c[3]
+		bottom = minf(bottom, cen.y - r.y * 0.8)
+		var base := m.v.size()
+		for e: Vector3 in ico[0]:
+			var p := cen + e * r
+			var n := (e / r).normalized()
+			if leafy:
+				n = (n + (p - crown).normalized() * 0.7).normalized()
+			m.add(p, n, col * (0.74 + 0.34 * (n.y * 0.5 + 0.5)))
+		for f: Array in ico[1]:
+			m.tri(base + int(f[0]), base + int(f[1]), base + int(f[2]))
+	m.glow = 0.0
+	if leafy and not wood.is_empty() and bottom > 0.3:
+		# The trunk: from the ground to inside the crown, as thick as the far mesh's at its foot.
+		var foot := 0.0
+		var nf := 0
+		var top := Vector2.ZERO
+		var nt := 0
+		var bark := Color(0, 0, 0)
+		for i in wood:
+			var p := vs[i]
+			bark += cs[i]
+			if p.y < minf(0.8, bottom * 0.3):
+				foot += Vector2(p.x, p.z).length()
+				nf += 1
+			elif absf(p.y - bottom) < 0.8:
+				top += Vector2(p.x, p.z)
+				nt += 1
+		bark /= wood.size()
+		var r0 := clampf(foot / maxf(nf, 1) * 0.9, 0.06, 1.2)
+		var tc := top / maxf(nt, 1)
+		var y1 := bottom + 0.6
+		m.leaf = 0.0
+		var base := m.v.size()
+		for ring in 2:
+			for s in 5:
+				var a := TAU * s / 5.0
+				var dir := Vector3(cos(a), 0.0, sin(a))
+				var p := dir * (r0 if ring == 0 else r0 * 0.55) + (Vector3(tc.x, y1, tc.y) if ring == 1 else Vector3.ZERO)
+				m.add(p, dir, bark)
+		for s in 5:
+			var s1 := (s + 1) % 5
+			m.quad(base + s, base + s1, base + 5 + s1, base + 5 + s)
+	return m.arrays()
+
+
+## Points `ids` of `vs` in `k` clusters (k-means from the farthest points - the
+## same every time): [centres, each point's cluster]. _clusters: [centre, radii, colour, glow] each.
+static func _kmeans(vs: PackedVector3Array, ids: PackedInt32Array, k: int) -> Array:
+	var cents: Array = []
+	var top := ids[0]
+	for i in ids:
+		if vs[i].y > vs[top].y:
+			top = i
+	cents.append(vs[top])
+	while cents.size() < k:
+		var best := ids[0]
+		var bd := -1.0
+		for i in ids:
+			var dd := INF
+			for c: Vector3 in cents:
+				dd = minf(dd, vs[i].distance_squared_to(c))
+			if dd > bd:
+				bd = dd
+				best = i
+		cents.append(vs[best])
+	var own := PackedInt32Array()
+	own.resize(vs.size())
+	for it in 6:
+		var sum: Array = []
+		var cnt := PackedInt32Array()
+		cnt.resize(k)
+		for c in k:
+			sum.append(Vector3.ZERO)
+		for i in ids:
+			var bi := 0
+			var bd := INF
+			for c in k:
+				var dd := vs[i].distance_squared_to(cents[c])
+				if dd < bd:
+					bd = dd
+					bi = c
+			own[i] = bi
+			sum[bi] += vs[i]
+			cnt[bi] += 1
+		for c in k:
+			if cnt[c] > 0:
+				cents[c] = sum[c] / cnt[c]
+	return [cents, own]
+
+
+static func _clusters(vs: PackedVector3Array, cs: PackedColorArray, uv: PackedVector2Array, ids: PackedInt32Array, own: PackedInt32Array, cents: Array) -> Array:
+	var out: Array = []
+	for c in cents.size():
+		var sq := Vector3.ZERO
+		var col := Color(0, 0, 0, 0)
+		var glow := 0.0
+		var n := 0
+		for i in ids:
+			if own[i] != c:
+				continue
+			var d: Vector3 = vs[i] - cents[c]
+			sq += d * d
+			col += cs[i]
+			glow += uv[i].x
+			n += 1
+		if n < 3:
+			continue
+		var r := Vector3(sqrt(sq.x / n), sqrt(sq.y / n), sqrt(sq.z / n)) * LOW_SPRAY
+		col /= n
+		col.a = 1.0
+		out.append([cents[c], r.max(Vector3.ONE * 0.08), col, glow / n])
+	return out
+
+
+# --- The impostors ---------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## (Worker) Every stand's far mesh drawn into one atlas, from the side and from
+## above (CELL px each; colour and coverage, the colours bled past the edges for
+## the mipmaps): {"image": Image (mipmapped), "grid": Vector2(cols, rows)}; each
+## stand's sp["imp"] = Vector4(atlas index, width, height, the top card's height / height).
+## `stop` [true]: given up ({}).
+static func bake(flora: Array, stop: Array = []) -> Dictionary:
+	var stands: Array = []
+	for sp: Dictionary in flora:
+		if is_stand(sp):
+			stands.append(sp)
+	var cells := maxi(stands.size() * 2, 1)
+	var rows := ceili(cells / float(COLS))
+	var w := COLS * CELL
+	var data := PackedByteArray()
+	data.resize(w * rows * CELL * 4)
+	for i in stands.size():
+		if not stop.is_empty() and stop[0]:
+			return {}   # (its world gone meanwhile)
+		var sp: Dictionary = stands[i]
+		var far: Array = sp["far"]
+		var b := _bounds(far)
+		var r := b.x * 1.02
+		var h := b.y * 1.02
+		var vs: PackedVector3Array = far[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX]
+		var uv2: PackedVector2Array = far[Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV2]
+		var ly := 0.0
+		var nl := 0
+		for j in vs.size():
+			if uv2[j].x > 0.5:
+				ly += vs[j].y
+				nl += 1
+		var topk := clampf((ly / nl) / h if nl > 0 else 0.6, 0.2, 0.9)
+		for view in 2:
+			var cell := i * 2 + view
+			_raster(far, view, r, h, data, w, (cell % COLS) * CELL, (cell / COLS) * CELL, stop)
+			if not stop.is_empty() and stop[0]:
+				return {}
+		sp["imp"] = Vector4(i, r * 2.0, h, topk)
+	var img := Image.create_from_data(w, rows * CELL, false, Image.FORMAT_RGBA8, data)
+	img.generate_mipmaps()
+	return {"image": img, "grid": Vector2(COLS, rows)}
+
+
+## One view of a mesh into the atlas at (ox, oy): 0 from the side (x across, y
+## up, nearest +z), 1 from above (x, z; highest y) - each triangle its vertices'
+## mean colour; then the colours bled two pixels out (coverage 0 there).
+static func _raster(arr: Array, view: int, r: float, h: float, data: PackedByteArray, w: int, ox: int, oy: int, stop: Array = []) -> void:
+	var vs: PackedVector3Array = arr[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX]
+	var cs: PackedColorArray = arr[Mesh.ARRAY_COLOR]
+	var ix: PackedInt32Array = arr[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX]
+	var N := CELL
+	var px := PackedVector3Array()   # (pixel x, pixel y, depth)
+	px.resize(vs.size())
+	for i in vs.size():
+		var p := vs[i]
+		if view == 0:
+			px[i] = Vector3((p.x + r) / (2.0 * r) * N, (h - p.y) / h * N, p.z)
+		else:
+			px[i] = Vector3((p.x + r) / (2.0 * r) * N, (p.z + r) / (2.0 * r) * N, p.y)
+	var zb := PackedFloat32Array()
+	zb.resize(N * N)
+	zb.fill(-INF)
+	var col := PackedColorArray()
+	col.resize(N * N)
+	for t in range(0, ix.size(), 3):
+		if t % 1500 == 0 and not stop.is_empty() and stop[0]:
+			return   # (its world gone: stop mid-way)
+		var a := px[ix[t]]
+		var b := px[ix[t + 1]]
+		var c := px[ix[t + 2]]
+		var area := (b.x - a.x) * (c.y - a.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (c.x - a.x)
+		if absf(area) < 1e-6:
+			continue
+		var tc := (cs[ix[t]] + cs[ix[t + 1]] + cs[ix[t + 2]]) / 3.0
+		var x0 := maxi(int(floor(minf(a.x, minf(b.x, c.x)))), 0)
+		var x1 := mini(int(ceil(maxf(a.x, maxf(b.x, c.x)))), N - 1)
+		var y0 := maxi(int(floor(minf(a.y, minf(b.y, c.y)))), 0)
+		var y1 := mini(int(ceil(maxf(a.y, maxf(b.y, c.y)))), N - 1)
+		var inv := 1.0 / area
+		for y in range(y0, y1 + 1):
+			var fy := y + 0.5
+			for x in range(x0, x1 + 1):
+				var fx := x + 0.5
+				var w0 := ((b.x - fx) * (c.y - fy) - (b.y - fy) * (c.x - fx)) * inv
+				var w1 := ((c.x - fx) * (a.y - fy) - (c.y - fy) * (a.x - fx)) * inv
+				var w2 := 1.0 - w0 - w1
+				if w0 < 0.0 or w1 < 0.0 or w2 < 0.0:
+					continue
+				var z := a.z * w0 + b.z * w1 + c.z * w2
+				var q := y * N + x
+				if z > zb[q]:
+					zb[q] = z
+					col[q] = tc
+	var cover := PackedByteArray()
+	cover.resize(N * N)
+	for q in N * N:
+		cover[q] = 255 if zb[q] > -INF else 0
+	var filled := cover.duplicate()
+	for pass_i in 2:   # (bleed the colours outward: no dark fringe in the mipmaps)
+		var next := filled.duplicate()
+		for y in N:
+			for x in N:
+				var q := y * N + x
+				if filled[q] != 0:
+					continue
+				var s := Color(0, 0, 0, 0)
+				var n := 0
+				for o: Vector2i in [Vector2i(1, 0), Vector2i(-1, 0), Vector2i(0, 1), Vector2i(0, -1)]:
+					var xx := x + o.x
+					var yy := y + o.y
+					if xx >= 0 and yy >= 0 and xx < N and yy < N and filled[yy * N + xx] != 0:
+						s += col[yy * N + xx]
+						n += 1
+				if n > 0:
+					col[q] = s / n
+					next[q] = 1
+		filled = next
+	for y in N:
+		for x in N:
+			var q := y * N + x
+			var o := ((oy + y) * w + ox + x) * 4
+			var c: Color = col[q]
+			data[o] = clampi(int(c.r * 255.0), 0, 255)
+			data[o + 1] = clampi(int(c.g * 255.0), 0, 255)
+			data[o + 2] = clampi(int(c.b * 255.0), 0, 255)
+			data[o + 3] = cover[q]
+
+
+static var _imp_mesh: ArrayMesh
+
+
+## The impostor: three upright cards crossed (60 degrees apart) and one across
+## the top (the shader sets its height: the plant's crown) - a unit plant (1
+## wide, 1 tall: its transform sizes it). UV2.x 7 + u, UV2.y -(20 + v) the side
+## view, -(22 + v) the top; normals round, as a crown's.
+static func impostor_arrays() -> Array:
+	var m := CosmosFlora.M.new()
+	m.sway = 0.0
+	m.leaf = 1.0
+	var a := (IMP * 8 + IMP + 0.5) / 128.0
+	var col := Color(1, 1, 1, a)
+	for k in 3:
+		var ang := PI * k / 3.0
+		var dir := Vector3(cos(ang), 0.0, sin(ang))
+		var base := m.v.size()
+		for q in 4:
+			var u := float(q == 1 or q == 2)
+			var t := float(q >= 2)
+			var p := dir * (u - 0.5) + Vector3(0, t, 0)
+			var n := (Vector3(p.x * 1.6, (t - 0.45) * 1.2 + 0.35, p.z * 1.6)).normalized()
+			m.v.append(p)
+			m.nr.append(n)
+			m.c.append(col)
+			m.uv.append(Vector2.ZERO)
+			m.uv2.append(Vector2(7.0 + u * 0.999, -(20.0 + t * 0.999)))
+		m.ix.append_array([base, base + 1, base + 2, base, base + 2, base + 3])
+	var base := m.v.size()
+	for q in 4:
+		var u := float(q == 1 or q == 2)
+		var t := float(q >= 2)
+		m.v.append(Vector3(u - 0.5, 0.6, t - 0.5))
+		m.nr.append(Vector3.UP)
+		m.c.append(col)
+		m.uv.append(Vector2.ZERO)
+		m.uv2.append(Vector2(7.0 + u * 0.999, -(22.0 + t * 0.999)))
+	m.ix.append_array([base, base + 1, base + 2, base, base + 2, base + 3])
+	return m.arrays()
+
+
+static func impostor_mesh() -> ArrayMesh:
+	if _imp_mesh == null:
+		_imp_mesh = ArrayMesh.new()
+		_imp_mesh.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, impostor_arrays())
+	return _imp_mesh
+
+
+# --- Their places on the patches --------------------------------------------------
+
+## (Worker) The plants a patch owns: those whose reach falls in [lo, hi) m - k ->
+## PackedFloat32Array of REC-float records. Each species its own seed (the
+## patch's and its own), candidates spread over the whole patch as many as its
+## density x the share of plants in that band, each kept by the woods' and its
+## territories' chance and how well it grows there (CosmosFlora.cluster, site).
+static func own(flora: Array, shape: PlanetShape, radius: float, seed: int, n: Vector3, u: Vector3, v: Vector3,
+		a0: float, b0: float, span: float, lo: float, hi: float) -> Dictionary:
+	var out := {}
+	var area := pow(span * radius * 0.9, 2.0) / 100.0
+	var step := 1.2 / radius
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	for k in flora.size():
+		var sp: Dictionary = flora[k]
+		if not is_stand(sp):
+			continue
+		var cap: float = sp.get("reach", TREE_REACH)
+		var top := minf(hi, cap)
+		if lo >= top:
+			continue
+		var f_lo := share(lo)
+		var f_hi := share(top)
+		if f_lo - f_hi <= 1e-6:
+			continue
+		rng.seed = hash([seed, k, 77])
+		var cnt := int(float(sp["density"]) * area * (f_lo - f_hi) + rng.randf())
+		var rec := PackedFloat32Array()
+		var tilt: float = sp["tilt"]
+		var small: float = float(sp["size"].x) * 0.65
+		for i in cnt:
+			var a := a0 + rng.randf() * span
+			var b := b0 + rng.randf() * span
+			var pick := rng.randf()
+			var reach_v := lerpf(f_hi, f_lo, rng.randf())
+			var d := PlanetShape.face_dir(n, u, v, a, b)
+			var ch := CosmosFlora.cluster(sp, d, radius)
+			if pick > ch:
+				continue
+			var h := shape.height(d)
+			var t := d.cross(Vector3.UP if absf(d.y) < 0.9 else Vector3.RIGHT).normalized()
+			var slope := absf(shape.height((d + t * step).normalized()) - h) / 1.2
+			if pick > ch * CosmosFlora.site(sp, shape, h, slope):
+				continue
+			var sc := CosmosFlora.size_of(sp, rng)
+			var reach := clampf(D0 / maxf(reach_v, 1e-4), lo, top)
+			if sc < small:
+				reach = minf(reach, 70.0)   # (the saplings: only near)
+			rec.append_array([a, b, d.x, d.y, d.z, h, 0.06 * sc + slope * 0.4 * sc, sc, rng.randf() * TAU,
+				rng.randf_range(-1, 1) * tilt, rng.randf_range(-1, 1) * tilt,
+				rng.randf_range(0.88, 1.12), rng.randf_range(0.88, 1.15), rng.randf_range(0.88, 1.12), reach])
+		if not rec.is_empty():
+			out[k] = rec
+	return out
+
+
+## The records of `all` on the square (a0, b0, span) - and `own` added.
+static func inherit(all: Dictionary, a0: float, b0: float, span: float, mine: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var out := {}
+	for k in all:
+		var src: PackedFloat32Array = all[k]
+		var rec := PackedFloat32Array()
+		for i in range(0, src.size(), REC):
+			var a := src[i]
+			var b := src[i + 1]
+			if a >= a0 and a < a0 + span and b >= b0 and b < b0 + span:
+				rec.append_array(src.slice(i, i + REC))
+		if not rec.is_empty():
+			out[k] = rec
+	for k in mine:
+		out[k] = (out.get(k, PackedFloat32Array()) as PackedFloat32Array) + (mine[k] as PackedFloat32Array)
+	return out
+
+
+## (Worker) A patch's plants as MultiMesh buffers (`bare`: PlanetShape's ground built over, a snapshot) (TRANSFORM_3D + custom: size m,
+## reach, atlas index + the top card's height, glow): {k: [buffer, count, sc min, sc max,
+## reach max, AABB]}, "imp": the impostors' (all species, one buffer) - and the solid
+## ones' trunks [point, radius, height] in `solids`. Set on the patch's own ground
+## (`hs`: its grid, PATCH + 3 a side) unless `exact` (the finest: on the true ground).
+static func build(flora: Array, shape: PlanetShape, radius: float, all: Dictionary, a0: float, b0: float, span: float,
+		centre: Vector3, hs: PackedFloat32Array, patch: int, exact: bool, digs: PackedFloat64Array, solids: Array, bare: Array = []) -> Dictionary:
+	var out := {}
+	var imp := PackedFloat32Array()
+	var imp_n := 0
+	var imp_box := AABB()
+	var imp_lo := INF
+	var imp_hi := 0.0
+	var imp_r := 0.0
+	var G := patch + 3
+	var step := span / patch
+	for k in all:
+		var sp: Dictionary = flora[k]
+		var src: PackedFloat32Array = all[k]
+		var ih: float = sp["h"]
+		var iv: Vector4 = sp.get("imp", Vector4(-1, 1, 1, 0.6))
+		var solid: float = sp["solid"]
+		var tall: float = sp["tall"]
+		var glow: float = sp["glow"]
+		var buf := PackedFloat32Array()
+		var cnt := 0
+		var smin := INF
+		var smax := 0.0
+		var rmax := 0.0
+		var box := AABB()
+		for i in range(0, src.size(), REC):
+			var d := Vector3(src[i + 2], src[i + 3], src[i + 4])
+			if shape.cleared(d) or _bare(d, bare) or shape.dug_here(d, digs):
+				continue
+			var h := src[i + 5]
+			if not exact and not hs.is_empty():
+				var fx := clampf((src[i] - a0) / step, 0.0, patch - 0.001)
+				var fy := clampf((src[i + 1] - b0) / step, 0.0, patch - 0.001)
+				var gx := int(fx)
+				var gy := int(fy)
+				fx -= gx
+				fy -= gy
+				var q := (gy + 1) * G + gx + 1
+				var h00 := hs[q]
+				var h11 := hs[q + G + 1]
+				if fx > fy:   # (the terrain's own triangles: CosmosPlanet._build)
+					h = h00 + fx * (hs[q + 1] - h00) + fy * (h11 - hs[q + 1])
+				else:
+					h = h00 + fy * (hs[q + G] - h00) + fx * (h11 - hs[q + G])
+			var sc := src[i + 7]
+			var t := d.cross(Vector3.UP if absf(d.y) < 0.9 else Vector3.RIGHT).normalized()
+			var x := t.rotated(d, src[i + 8])
+			var bs := Basis(x, d, x.cross(d)) * Basis.from_euler(Vector3(src[i + 9], 0.0, src[i + 10])) \
+				* Basis.from_scale(Vector3(src[i + 11], src[i + 12], src[i + 13]) * sc)
+			var at := d * (radius + h - src[i + 6])
+			var o := at - centre
+			var reach := src[i + 14]
+			var size := ih * sc
+			_put(buf, bs, o, Vector4(size, reach, maxf(iv.x, 0.0) + iv.w * 0.98, glow))
+			cnt += 1
+			smin = minf(smin, sc)
+			smax = maxf(smax, sc)
+			rmax = maxf(rmax, reach)
+			var ext := Vector3.ONE * size * 1.2
+			var pb := AABB(o - ext, ext * 2.0)
+			box = pb if cnt == 1 else box.merge(pb)
+			if iv.x >= 0.0 and reach > x_of(IMP - LOD_T * 0.5) * size:
+				var ib := bs * Basis.from_scale(Vector3(iv.y, iv.z, iv.y))
+				_put(imp, ib, o, Vector4(size, reach, iv.x + iv.w * 0.98, glow))
+				imp_box = pb if imp_n == 0 else imp_box.merge(pb)
+				imp_n += 1
+				imp_lo = minf(imp_lo, size)
+				imp_hi = maxf(imp_hi, size)
+				imp_r = maxf(imp_r, reach)
+			if solid > 0.0 and solids != null and exact:
+				solids.append([at, solid * sc, tall * sc])
+		if cnt > 0:
+			out[k] = [buf, cnt, smin, smax, rmax, box]
+	if imp_n > 0:
+		out["imp"] = [imp, imp_n, imp_lo, imp_hi, imp_r, imp_box]   # (sizes in m, not scales)
+	return out
+
+
+## Ground built over (PlanetShape.bare, from its list as the main thread had it -
+## not read while it's being replaced).
+static func _bare(d: Vector3, list: Array) -> bool:
+	for b in list:
+		if d.dot(b[0]) < b[1]:
+			continue
+		var dirs: PackedVector3Array = b[2]
+		var coss: PackedFloat32Array = b[3]
+		for i in dirs.size():
+			if d.dot(dirs[i]) > coss[i]:
+				return true
+	return false
+
+
+static func _put(b: PackedFloat32Array, bs: Basis, o: Vector3, c: Vector4) -> void:
+	b.append_array([bs.x.x, bs.y.x, bs.z.x, o.x, bs.x.y, bs.y.y, bs.z.y, o.y, bs.x.z, bs.y.z, bs.z.z, o.z, c.x, c.y, c.z, c.w])
+
+
+## The distance band (m) a level's meshes draw for plants of size `size` - with
+## the crossfade either side: [from, to].
+static func band_m(lo: int, hi: int, size_lo: float, size_hi: float) -> Vector2:
+	var bx := band_x(lo, hi)
+	var a: float = bx.x * size_lo
+	var b: float = bx.y * size_hi
+	return Vector2(a, b)
hunks.title: Trees to the horizon
hunks.note: The chain (near, thinned, mid, far, low, impostor), the impostor atlas baked on a worker, and the placement shared down the quadtree so a patch and its children show the same plants.

bubbles.text: The level bands, as distance over the plant's size, so a big tree keeps its leaves further than a small one.
Every plant is drawn this near; further out a share falling with distance, so a forest stays a forest at a fraction of the plants.
The low level: the far mesh's leaves clustered into a few ellipsoids round a trunk.
